info.title: worker-protocol — queries
info.description: Reading what a Worker holds that this protocol does not name. The Descriptor is the catalog: each Query declares the schema of its parameters and of what it answers, and this surface answers and never lists what exists.

servers.description: QRY-1. The address the `queries` entry declares, resolved per DESC-36.

address.description: Read from the Worker's Descriptor and resolved per DESC-36. Never assembled by a caller (ENDP-1). The default is `/` and not a host on purpose: a client that was never given an address should fail at its own origin rather than reach somebody else's.

get.description: QRY-5. A read the Worker defines, named in `query`, with each parameter it declares sent under its own name. A GET, so it changes nothing a later reader could observe (ENDP-2) and a caller that got no answer reads again.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: QRY-5. One of the Queries the entry declares. Naming none is `400`; naming one it does not declare is `404`; naming one the credential presented does not cover is `403` (QRY-10), before its parameters are judged.

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: QRY-5. Each parameter the Query declares, sent under exactly its own name and at most once, against the JSON Schema its entry declares (QRY-8). The names are the Worker's own and are read from its Descriptor, so they are not enumerated here.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: ENDP-21. Opaque, produced only by the Worker, never constructed by a caller. Absent from an answer at the end of the collection.

parameters.name: Worker-Protocol-Capability-Version
parameters.description: ENDP-6. The Capability version the caller expects. A Worker that cannot answer it refuses the request whole with `400` and `unsupported_version`, and never substitutes its own.

parameters.name: traceparent
parameters.description: ENDP-42. W3C Trace Context. The Worker continues the trace this names, in a span of its own, or begins one where the header is absent or cannot be read — and never refuses a request for it. LOG-11: a record written while handling the call carries that trace.

200.description: QRY-9. The document the Query declares under `result`, or the shared page envelope carrying the items it declares under `items`. Either is against the Query's own declared schema, so no shape is fixed here.

Worker-Protocol-Edition.description: ENDP-37. The edition that produced this answer. A caller that sees one it did not expect re-reads the Descriptor rather than parsing the body.

Worker-Protocol-Capability-Version.description: ENDP-37. The Capability version that produced this answer, on every response from an address a Capability entry declares.

400.description: ENDP-39. The shared error envelope, carrying one of: `invalid_parameter` (QRY-7), `invalid_parameter` (QRY-8), `unknown_filter` (ENDP-24), `unsupported_version` (ENDP-6).
